answer_1.quote: Long-form question answering (LFQA) is an important benchmark task whose performance reflects the reliability of these AI systems at providing comprehensive and accurate responses to user queries.

answer_2.quote: performance on this dataset is evaluated by 1. 'Str_EM': checking if reference short answers have an exact match in the LLM generated answer, 2. 'QA-F1': Does an external QA model identify these short answers from reference disambiguating questions. Additionally, we also present the 'Mauve' score which compares the fluency and style of the model generated text to the reference answer. ... 'Precision', 'Recall', 'F1', 'Recall-5(100 if atleast 5 correct entities are present)' are used to evaluate QAMPARI and QUEST.
